summary: Iteration 17 - Phone-First Login Flow Testing. Tested new unified phone-based authentication flow with 3 steps: phone entry, password (login/create), and profile (new users only). Fixed critical bug where phone number was sent without +33 prefix. Fixed fetchUser reference error in LoginPage.js. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend flow working for both existing and new users.

integration_issues.issue: Shows generic 'Erreur de connexion' instead of API error 'Mot de passe incorrect'. The catch block is triggered instead of handling the 401 response properly.

action_items: MINOR: Improve error handling in LoginPage.js to show API error messages instead of generic 'Erreur de connexion' for 401 responses
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Phone number was being sent without +33 prefix - added getFullPhone() helper function
FIXED: LoginPage.js was using undefined 'fetchUser' - changed to use 'setUser' from AuthContext
All data-testid attributes properly maintained for testing

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone-first login flow fully implemented and tested. Three backend endpoints working: POST /api/auth/check-phone, POST /api/auth/phone-login, POST /api/auth/phone-register. Frontend LoginPage.js has 3 steps: phone → password → profile (new users only). Fixed phone prefix bug and fetchUser reference error. Minor issue: wrong password shows generic error instead of API message.

phone_prefix_bug.issue: Phone number sent without +33 prefix causing check-phone to return exists=false for existing users
phone_prefix_bug.fix: Added getFullPhone() helper that prepends '+33 ' to phone number before API calls

fetchUser_reference_error.issue: fetchUser was not exported from AuthContext, causing login to fail
fetchUser_reference_error.fix: Changed to use setUser(data.user) directly from the API response
